Don't fade the tape — narrow it.

executive_summary: Overnight tape is a study in cross-currents. S&P futures are flat, Dow futures -0.16%, Nasdaq futures fractionally lower as Brent crude breaks back above $107 on stalled US-Iran talks and tighter Iranian control over the Strait of Hormuz. Intel's Q1 blowout (+25-30% premarket) and MaxLinear's data center guide raise (+57%) are propping the semi complex into a packed earnings week (MSFT/META Wed, AAPL/AMZN Thu). The 10Y sits at 4.31% — up 7bp on the week — with the FOMC on hold tomorrow and March CPI at 3.3% YoY hardening sticky-inflation narratives. Verizon and Domino's report premarket; Nucor after the close. Defense, energy, and tankers are the cleanest geopolitical longs; airlines and rate-sensitive consumer remain the cleanest funding shorts.

macro_events.title: Iran peace talks stall; Strait of Hormuz effectively closed for 9th week
macro_events.causal_chain: Iran re-imposed tighter strait control within hours of reopening — gunfire on tankers, vessels turning back. 21% of global oil and 20% of LNG flow disrupted -> war-risk insurance premiums spike on VLCCs (Cape of Good Hope rerouting adds ~12-14 days, +$2M/trip) -> Brent breaks $107, WTI $94-96 -> Asian refiners scramble for replacement crude -> Qatar LNG diversions threaten European TTF supply -> US gasoline prices feed back into May CPI -> Fed cut path delayed further -> 10Y yield drift higher -> multiples compress for high-duration growth ex-AI infrastructure.
macro_events.geographic_dimension: Persian Gulf chokepoint affects ~21% of global oil trade; Asian refiners (China, India, Japan, S. Korea) most exposed; European LNG buyers face Qatar re-route risk.
macro_events.historical_analog: September 2019 Abqaiq attack — Brent +15% in 24h, tanker rates ran 20-35% in a week; 1990 Gulf invasion — Brent doubled in two months.
macro_events.counterargument: Government sources flagged a 'high likelihood of breakthrough' in US-Iran talks; an unexpected ceasefire could collapse the energy premium and snap defense/tanker positioning sharply lower.
